steps.title: Open the exact source review in its fixed frame
preconditions: Reuse the complete unchanged named native journey with its matching automation-enabled Catalyst app and fresh owned synthetic workspace. This catalog records static source/assertion associations; native runs, measured counters and release signing remain separate.

Use journeys/generation-review --group review. The native journey saves the startup YAM MAN sentinel, production-imports generation-review-fixture, verifies its entries/characters/cues and empty image jobs, captures both saved projects, and selects Script before opening Review brief.

The source fixture has authored passages and two resolved characters with no local portraits. Assertions compare every source ID/text and person-link ID with the independent fixture, the current picture title and empty-direction text; they also constrain the scroll body below the fixed header and above the fixed footer.

Current-scope checks support this unchanged live review only. No stale source/account/navigation invalidation, snapshot-only initializer, portrait loading, Copy handler, empty-source fallback or size matrix is claimed.

expectations.description: The initial real review displays the exact imported source/people identities and picture title, no unrelated sentinel, exact empty-direction messages, three literal tabs and a positive source viewport bounded by the fixed header/footer; both saved projects and zero jobs are preserved.

The controller retains the actual review view whose exact source content and bounded frame are observed.

Normal loading creates the actual view with its captured snapshot and dismissal closure. This slice witnesses construction; clipboard closure contents on subsequent lines are excluded.
The built review view is mounted in the controller. The source viewport and header/footer are observed in that real hierarchy.
First load performs the current-source refresh before the asserted valid source review is shown.

The unchanged live store passes current navigation/scope/scene/cue/image/context comparisons and the loaded-view guard. A false current check would clear the asserted source; no stale or snapshot-only branch is claimed.
The first refresh leaves this current review valid, preserving the exact source controls. Invocation of invalidate for changed source is explicitly outside this witness.

The real review root identifier is used by the journey chrome and close observers.
Header/footer identities bind the independent viewport boundary assertions to the actual fixed containers.
The mounted header contains the picture label whose exact current-picture text is independently checked. Title typography and close-button appearance are not claimed.

The Done footer and separately constrained header/body/exact containers are mounted. Current-frame geometry and unchanged chrome across later navigation are asserted, not decorative dividers or unavailable-state appearance.

The independently specified people order is June, Mara, June; each source-link activation is followed by collapse and expand of that exact person.

The oracle checks requested header visibility fully within the scroll frame, complete Unicode aliases/appearance/biography, actual profile-grid membership and disappearance on collapse, plus invariant header/footer/Done geometry. mappings.why: Expanded identity membership and keyed header state support the exact person disclosure and reveal checks.
A source identity link enters showPerson and passes its current-view/member guard for the actual requested captured person. Unknown identity and invalidated-view rejection are excluded.

The scheduled reveal retains the requested header only while the same valid People view still owns it. The target is then independently observed inside the viewport; retired-target/race failures are not claimed.

Normal reveal settles header/content geometry and passes the positive bounds guard before scrolling the exact requested header into view. The independent frame assertions cover the successful result, not retry exhaustion or a precise layout-pass count.
The requested header rectangle is bounded and scrolled into view. Its whole native frame is checked, not a lower profile fragment; the asynchronous closure then completes.
Actual person-button activation passes valid/current-member guards and changes the named expansion membership, directly observed as Expanded/Collapsed and profile-grid presence.
A toggle rebuilds the keyed person headers and body to expose or remove the expected complete profile grid. Offset restoration is separately excluded.
The People builder constructs the independently checked person-specific disclosure hierarchy.
Each captured person gets a keyed native header with matching identity and expansion value; the exact requested header is activated and its state asserted.
The header/details content is mounted and the expanded branch creates a profile only for the expanded identity. Avatar size, row alignment and spacing are not asserted.
The expanded profile includes the complete aliases text checked against the independent Unicode fixture; no empty-alias fallback is claimed.
The expanded profile includes the complete biography value checked against the fixture; descriptive note wording and empty-profile fallback are not asserted.
The profile receives its exact person-specific identifier and is mounted only in the expanded content. Collapse/expand assertions check its removal and reappearance.
Profile-row construction places each complete captured value in a native text view. The witness compares the text, not title width or typography.
Each captured value is mounted in its returned profile row. Row alignment and spacing are not independently asserted.
The mounted value row is returned for inclusion in the independently checked profile grid.

The full journey checks exact three frozen instruction labels through two open/close disclosure cycles, preserving untouched executable/endpoint field values and a disconnected/error-free setup. Untouched field comparisons establish preservation of observed values, not correct default preference resolution or preference writes. Empty-job observations are not evidence that GenerationJournal initialized or recovered successfully.
